correctness.rationale: Musin gives \(L_k(r,b_r)\le\varepsilon\) for every prime and \(\varepsilon\le U_k(r,b_r)\) for present primes. If \(q\mid n\), then \(\varepsilon\le U_k(q,1)\); if \(p\nmid n\), then \(L_k(p,0)\le\varepsilon\). The cross-inequality therefore forces \(p\mid n\). Independent high-precision evaluation confirmed all 23 positive adjacent margins through 89, with minimum about \(1.94\times10^{-5}\), and a negative \(89\to97\) margin about \(-4.47\times10^{-5}\); the exact verifier certifies them using rational logarithm intervals.
